gen-gf-sniglet-gf-sarala: Sniglet stops its strokes short, never curling them back. Sarala sits beneath in a plain sans, its gaps between letter parts distinct, with a stroke like neon tubing; try the body a notch smaller than you'd expect.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Sniglet draws its g in one unchanging line weight, and the whole heading feels quietly commanding. Sawarabi Gothic follows with open jaws on every curve, which is the pair's real strength: a loud top and a patient sans-serif beneath.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-shanti: Shanti reads modern and businesslike, with a generous entry into the eye of its e that makes each line feel easy to enter. Sniglet, with no thick-to-thin shifts, sounds distinctive beside it.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-shippori-antique: Sniglet stops its terminals short of curling back, giving headings a level, commanding beat. And Shippori Antique, a plain sans with open bowls and one monoweight skeleton, can take a slightly larger size than usual.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-shippori-antique-b1: Sniglet's terminals stop short of curling back in, which gives a heading a distinctive, level, quiet authority. Shippori Antique B1 does the opposite job, letting daylight through every curve like a fixed-width stencil brush across a plain sans line.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-sn-pro: SN Pro keeps its apertures open across the whole alphabet. Sniglet is best at pulling strokes like solder through a nozzle for a headline, while the sans below does best at plain, modern, steady reading.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-sour-gummy: Sour Gummy leaves wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, a modern, neutral sans. But Sniglet does what it does best up top, cutting each letter like sign-shop vinyl at a single line width.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-source-sans-3: Source Sans 3 reads modern and businesslike, its a opening the lower bowl to breathe. Sniglet's terminals end at the same width they began, and that tidy, distinctive heading is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-spinnaker: Spinnaker reads modern and contemporary, its apertures linking counters to the space outside. Sniglet brings rope-like consistency in every stem, bowl and tail, so the plain sans below it feels like a quieter continuation.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-stick: Commanding and distinctive, Sniglet stops its terminals short of curling back in, with a quiet, level beat across each line. Stick does best at tubelike, constant-weight reading in a plain sans.
